beats.why: The happy, non-threatening face and casual walk read as a normal new neighbor, so the viewer dropped the 'monster' framing entirely.
The theatre mask reads as interpersonal pretense between the two women, not the narration's point about willful social blindness letting the vampire feed unimpeded.
With no on-screen text, the house/highway imagery only describes the setting and misses the narration's point that violence is finally crossing into their own neighborhood.
